en: Color view of a European old town square with historic gabled houses lined along the right side and a green lawn or park on the left. In the background rises a tall, slender medieval tower with a dark spire, characteristic of a town hall. The buildings have red-tiled roofs, stone facades, and ornate details. People are walking and gathering near the base of the buildings. The image has the look of a printed tourist postcard; no visible caption or writing appears on the front.
